# ICPay

> Fast, secure custodial ICP wallet, decentralized on-chain cloud storage (icBucket), and Web3 developer platform built on the Internet Computer.

ICPay (https://icpay.app) is an Internet Computer (ICP) native platform featuring a custodial multi-token wallet, human-readable username handles, high-throughput on-chain storage with an edge CDN, one-click ICRC token launching, and canister management tooling.

For the comprehensive, complete text documentation and technical specs, see:
- [Complete Agent Documentation](https://icpay.app/llms-full.txt)

## Quick Facts & Architecture
- **Website**: https://icpay.app
- **Official Domains**: https://icpay.app, https://icpay.cloud, https://icbucket.app, https://onchainstorage.shop
- **Storage CDN**: https://cloud.icpay.app (Edge cached reverse proxy to canister storage)
- **Primary Support**: contact@icpay.cloud
- **Backend Canister (On-Chain Motoko)**: `6vbhm-nqaaa-aaaan-q6muq-cai`
- **Frontend Asset Canister**: `63dke-waaaa-aaaan-q6mvq-cai`
- **Internet Identity Derivation Origin**: `https://63dke-waaaa-aaaan-q6mvq-cai.icp0.io`
- **Official ICP Ledger Canister**: `ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai`
- **Official ICP Index Canister**: `qhbym-qaaaa-aaaaa-aaafq-cai`
- **Authentication**: Internet Identity only (Passkeys, WebAuthn, biometric). Zero passwords, zero seed phrases stored.
- **Custody Model**: Each user possesses an isolated, deterministic subaccount on the backend canister derived from their Internet Identity principal. Only the authenticated principal can execute transfers or withdrawals.

## Core Products & Public Landing Pages
- [ICPay Home](https://icpay.app/): Main platform overview for sending, receiving, and managing ICP and ICRC tokens.
- [icBucket Cloud Storage Overview](https://icpay.app/icbucket): Decentralized S3-compatible cloud storage on the Internet Computer. Predictable 30-day ICP plans, zero egress fees, and AWS S3 pricing alternative.
- [icBucket Product Details](https://icpay.app/products/icBucket): In-depth product features, security specs, and architecture overview.
- [icBucket Storage Packages](https://icpay.app/products/icBucket/packages): 30-day storage plans from 0.5 ICP (1GB, 5GB, 10GB, 25GB, 50GB, 100GB+).
- [icFalcon Framework](https://icpay.app/icfalcon): High-performance developer CLI and canister operations suite.
- [icFalcon Packages](https://icpay.app/products/icFalcon/packages): Developer command suites and packages.
- [icFalcon Commands](https://icpay.app/products/icFalcon/commands): Complete CLI command reference.
- [Token Launcher](https://icpay.app/token/create): Launch custom ICRC-1 / ICRC-2 tokens on the Internet Computer in one click.
- [Canister Manager](https://icpay.app/canister/manage): Deploy, monitor cycles, snapshot, and manage ICP canisters.
- [Canister Tools](https://icpay.app/canister/tools): Canister developer tools and cycles management.
- [Topup & Cycles](https://icpay.app/topup): Convert ICP to cycles and top up canisters directly via cycles ledger.
- [Community Channels](https://icpay.app/channels): On-chain community channels and token-gated discussions.
- [Charity](https://icpay.app/charity): Transparent, verified on-chain donation campaigns.

## Authenticated Web Application (Requires Internet Identity)
- [Wallet Dashboard](https://icpay.app/wallet): Multi-token wallet balances, addresses, subaccounts, and transaction history.
- [Bucket Workspace](https://icpay.app/bucket): Interactive cloud file manager, folder creation, and drag-and-drop uploads.

## Developer Documentation & APIs
- [icBucket Documentation](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs): REST, Python SDK, and TypeScript SDK integration guides for icBucket.
- [Quickstart Guide](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/getting-started/quickstart): 5-minute guide to upload and retrieve files.
- [API Authentication](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/api/auth): Generate and manage read/write API keys for scripts, bots, and agents.
- [API Methods & Endpoints](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/api/methods): Full reference for listFolder, uploadChunk, and getFile.
- [CDN URL Structure](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/cdn/urls): Global CDN edge routing via `https://cloud.icpay.app/cloud/{bucketName}/{filePath}`.
- [Python SDK](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/sdk/python): Python client library for icBucket.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://icpay.app/bucket/docs/sdk/typescript): TypeScript client library for Node.js and browser environments.
